item.description: ### Highlights - **Image Generation by Default**: When a connected provider supports image models, agents can now use experimental_image_generate without additional configuration. Set its preferred model through experimental.image_generate.model. (#60258) - **Faster Worktree Selection**: On the new-session screen, click the current Git branch to open that project’s “Run session in” worktree picker directly. (#60263) - **Unified Quotes and Annotations**: Timeline quotes, terminal quotes, and browser annotations now share a compact optional-comment editor, while source highlights remain attached to local drafts. (#60164) ### Core #### Improvements - Enabled experimental_image_generate by default when an image-capable provider is connected. (#60258) - Recorded the start time of each session’s latest execution. #### Bug fixes - Rejected persistent terminal requests whose working directory no longer exists. - Preserved media when sessions are forked or imported. - Associated image-generation notices with the correct background job. ### TUI #### Bug fixes - Preserved captured attachments and their original source paths. Thanks @OpeOginni. (#60222) - Prevented middle-truncated paths from overflowing at very narrow terminal widths. - Improved Go usage-limit messages with the reset time and account page link. - Correctly typed and displayed Go and ChatGPT usage-limit errors. ### Desktop #### Improvements - Made the Git branch on the new-session screen open the current project’s worktree picker directly. (#60263) - Unified timeline quotes, terminal quotes, and browser annotations around one optional-comment workflow. (#60164) - Restored classic question cards by default and added **Settings → Experimental → New question UI** for the redesigned keyboard-oriented dock. (#59723) - Added a side-panel tab menu and kept close buttons visible when tabs overflow. - Moved user-message actions into a compact menu. - Redesigned the active todo pill to show the current task and concurrent work more clearly. - Added consistent styling for searchable dialogs and composer pills. #### Bug fixes - Stopped queued prompts from dropping frames as their content grows. - Counted queued quotes and browser annotations as attachments. - Reported failures to persist composer attachments through the normal error UI. - Made Markdown fragment links scroll to the referenced heading. - Kept each tab’s timeline state when switching directories. - Ordered the inbox’s **Working** shelf by execution start time. - Fixed side-panel launchers and automatic closing when the final tab is removed. - Focused the matching navigation arrow while reviewing changes. - Preserved pending model labels only when a queued prompt actually changes models. - Added reset details, an account link, and a composer tray for Go usage limits. ### SDK #### Improvements - Added if and until inputs for client.experimental.schedule.create, plus schedule check results and output fields. (#60137) - Exposed SessionInfo.time.busy for the latest execution’s start time. - Added optional source metadata to prompt file attachments. ### Extensions #### Improvements - Added optional title and subtitle fields to composer notes, source-relative quote positioning, and focus options for composer integrations. (#60164) #### Bug fixes - Corrected visible flowchart edges connected through Merman subgraphs.

item.description: ### Highlights - **Keep Working Toward a Goal**: Run /goal in the TUI or Desktop to let the session continue until a reviewer confirms the objective is met. Use /goal pause, /goal resume, or /goal clear to control it. (#59437) - **Generate Images**: Enable experimental.image_generate to let agents create or edit images with the new image_generate tool. You can optionally set its default model with experimental.image_generate.model. (#59939, #60096) - **Inspect Background Shells**: Click a running shell in the Desktop activity pill to see its live output and stop it without leaving the menu. (#59496) - **New Default Model Picker**: Search favorites, recent models, providers, and variants from the redesigned model picker, which is now the default in Desktop. (#59997) ### Breaking changes #### @opencode/ai provider removals and renames These changes affect code that imports @opencode/ai directly. They don't change the CLI, Desktop, or the HTTP API. - The fal, Black Forest Labs, Replicate, and Stability providers are removed, along with their ./providers/fal, ./providers/black-forest-labs, ./providers/replicate, and ./providers/stability entry points. (#59977) - Five legacy entry points are removed. Import the nested paths instead, which 2.2.0 already exports: ./providers/amazon-bedrock-mantle → ./providers/amazon-bedrock/mantle, and ./providers/google-vertex-chat, -interactions, -mistral, and -responses → ./providers/google-vertex/chat, /interactions, /mistral, and /responses. (#59506) - Each provider's configure() input type is now named Config, for example Groq.LanguageModelOptions → Groq.Config, and model() settings are optional when every setting is optional. (#59765) ### Core #### Improvements - Add /goal with pause, resume, and clear controls, plus automatic progress review until the objective is met. (#59437) - Add opt-in scheduled prompts through /schedule, agent tools, and experimental.schedules. (#59401, #59457) - Add the opt-in image_generate tool for background image creation and editing, with automatic or configured model selection. (#59939, #60096) - Offer GPT Image 2 after Codex sign-in and add MiniMax and Meta Muse image generation support. (#60085, #59929, #60081) - Add Responses API support for OpenRouter, DigitalOcean, and Venice, including freeform tools. (#59991, #59963) - Improve snapshot performance by coalescing captures and avoiding repeated ignore-file work. (#59419) #### Bug fixes - Preserve more context headroom when fitting tool output into the context window. (#59934) - Retry provider throttling correctly instead of reporting it as context overflow. (#59649) - Send image-edit references and image sizes in the formats expected by OpenRouter, Google, and Vercel Grok. (#60067, #59927) - Keep credential metadata and prompt-cache settings out of model settings and variants. (#60057, #59500) - Keep Git snapshots working in repositories that use a split index. (#59417) - Expose Console web search only when the workspace enables it. (#59592) - Improve Code Mode diagnostics for parse errors, stalled awaits, and promise-like search results. (#59834, #59749, #59981) ### TUI #### Improvements - Show /goal status below the prompt and provide a dialog for pausing, resuming, or clearing it. (#59437) #### Bug fixes - Show execution failures that occur before the first model step. (#60079) - Keep the activity spinner visible while a continued subagent runs. (#59950) - Send pasted image and PDF paths correctly when connected to a local server. (#59833) - Improve spacing in an empty /usage dialog. Thanks @Tarquinen. (#59918) ### Desktop #### Improvements - Add /reload to reload configuration without restarting. (#59887) - Make the redesigned searchable model picker the default, with dedicated Favorites and Recent sections and keyboard-accessible provider controls. (#59997) - Show live output and a Stop action when you select a background shell from the activity pill. (#59496) - Show /goal state and actions in a composer pill. (#59437) - Redesign the integrations dialog and always include OpenCode free models in the model picker. (#59976, #60047) - Add project, worktree, open-in-app, and terminal actions to the session location menu. (#59607) - Refine project and worktree selection, command search, prompt-history focus, composer model labels, and artifact preview controls. (#59397, #59604, #59626, #59735, #59657) - Highlight quoted timeline content while you write its first comment. (#59286) - Keep draft attachment bytes local when using experimental media URIs. (#59104) #### Bug fixes - Follow each plugin server’s configured endpoint when connecting to its event stream. (#60087) - Treat the reachable scroll boundary as the end when Desktop zoom is active. (#60034) - Prevent shell text from showing through copy buttons and avoid restyling the transcript when closing a side panel. (#59901, #59878) - Keep rendering malformed tool metadata instead of crashing the timeline. (#59736) - Make dropdowns open immediately and keep the new-session location shortcut working after tooltip interactions. (#59268, #59680) - Remove edge halos from macOS application icons. (#59900) ### SDK #### Improvements - Add client.experimental.schedule.{create,list,get,pause,resume,delete} for managing scheduled prompts. (#59457) - Group experimental generated-client methods under client.experimental; previous locations remain as deprecated aliases until the next minor release. (#59072) - Expose compaction through the Promise AI client. (#59987) - Add freeform tool support and Responses routes for OpenRouter, DigitalOcean, and Venice. (#59963, #59991) ### Extensions #### Improvements - Add the experimental experimental.idle Session hook so plugins can continue work before a session goes idle. (#59437) - Let Code Mode extension globals return Effects and declare required services. (#59948) - Add custom composer-pill popovers for GUI plugins. (#59437)

Instead of editing the system prompt and busting the prompt cache, each change is added as a small update at the next step. The entries also survive compaction and reverts, and they don't start an extra model turn. Plugins that depend on OpenTUI 0.6 fail to install until they upgrade. In OpenTUI 0.7, custom renderables read their hooks from their class at construction: assign renderBefore, renderAfter, and onLifecyclePass in the constructor instead of as class fields, call refreshHooks() after adding a hook by reflection, and replace defineNativeIntegration() with a static nativeIntegration declaration. item.description: ## Core ### Bugfixes - OpenCode 1 now stays on the 1.x release line: update checks use only the npm opencode-ai latest version, so 1.x installs are never offered a 2.x build as a regular update. - Upgrading to OpenCode 2 remains a separate, explicit choice through the 2.0 offer in /update or opencode upgrade --major. - Fix upgrades for installs managed by yarn. - Skip 1.x updates for Homebrew Core installs, which now track OpenCode 2, and check tap and Chocolatey availability before offering an update. - The install script refuses to install 2.x versions.
